summary: Master managing governance risks with ISO 31000 and COSO ERM frameworks. Enhance board reporting and cross-border compliance. Enroll at Trainingcred today.
lede: Managing Governance Risks gives professionals a structured way to identify vulnerabilities, assess threats, and connect governance practices with strategic objectives. The course develops capabilities in regulatory mapping, ESG integration, GRC technology, and executive risk reporting while addressing the gap between policy and practice. Through hands-on risk modeling, you will work with ISO 37000, COSO-aligned risk appetite statements, and COBIT principles for internal control design. Over five days, the course helps you move from reactive risk management toward proactive oversight supported by actionable intelligence and a geopolitical resilience plan.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for maintaining the integrity and compliance of global operations within complex organizational structures.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three to five years of experience in a management, legal, audit, or compliance role. A foundational understanding of corporate structures and basic financial reporting is required. Familiarity with the ISO 31000 or COSO ERM frameworks is beneficial but not mandatory, as core concepts will be reviewed during the first day of the program.
